metadata.title: Three-dimensional noncompact trans-Sasakian $η$-Einstein manifolds
metadata.abstract: We classify connected, simply connected, noncompact three-dimensional trans-Sasakian $\eta$-Einstein manifolds. In [1], we showed that, in the compact case, such a manifold is either of $\beta$-Kenmotsu type or homothetic to a Sasakian manifold. In this paper, in the noncompact case, we find families of trans-Sasakian $\eta$-Einstein manifolds that are neither $\beta$-Kenmotsu nor homothetic to Sasakian manifolds. These families have infinitely many degrees of freedom. We give these nontrivial metrics explicitly. We also give a structure theorem for the case in which the characteristic vector field is Palais-nonregular.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 非紧三维 trans-Sasakian 结构分类
analysis.workSummary: 分类连通、单连通、非紧三维 trans-Sasakian η-Einstein 流形，给出既非 β-Kenmotsu、也不与 Sasakian 结构相似的显式非平凡度量族，且具有无限自由度。对特征向量场 Palais 非正则的情形另有结构定理。
techniques: 特征流的 Palais 非正则结构
analysis.breakthrough: 展示非紧情形比既有紧情形二分具有更多模量与结构。
analysis.limitations: 需保留三维、单连通与非紧条件；摘要未说明是否假设度量完备，不能自动补上完备分类，也不能将无限自由度理解为有限维参数族。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 致谢明确披露AI用于检查证明、查找既有工作、识别可用于证明的现成定理和英文校对，并明确否认使用AI生成定理或证明。因此记verification、literature、writing，不记ideas/proofs。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊接触型几何的分类工作，对相关结构读者有价值，优先级次于曲率与流。
